## Updates
* CPython 3.15.0rc1 -> 3.15.0rc2
* expat 2.8.3 -> 2.8.4
* setuptools 82.0.1 -> 84.0.0


## Distribution changes
* On Linux, static musl builds do not include a shared _testclinic module..
* On Linux, musl builds are built with the same version of libffi as glibc builds, currently 3.4.8.
* Linux artifacts include a GNU build IDs in binaries and shared libraries.
 
## Build system changes
* For Python 3.12+, `PYTHON.json` is derived from build artifacts on Linux and macOS.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/astral-sh/python-build-standalone/compare/20260825...20260901
